name: studio-view-toggle
note: Round 7 studio IA (operator UAT 2026-08-09, from live-site testing of a saved original): (1) 'need to toggle between COF and fretboard, leaving play/tempo always shown' - a Fretboard|Circle seg rides the pinned controls row, ONE theory visual at a time, choice persisted (music.studioView.v1); (2) the videoless burger is GONE ('only item in collapsed menu is find yt video... the menu takes the settings menu location causing confusion') - replaced by a slim always-visible Add-a-video row that toggles the same gated paste box; (3) 'highlight the chords used in the song if known' - chips the song's seq actually uses light with the accent outline (base-triad match, so Am7 lights Am). Path: compose C-G-Am-F, Solo, Save & open Studio - the saved payload carries seq.

steps.label: FRETBOARD is the default view: seg present with Fretboard on, the scale visible, the circle hidden - and play/speed stay pinned beside the seg
steps.js: (function(){var seg=document.querySelector('[data-stviewseg]');if(!seg)return false;var on=seg.querySelector('[data-stview="fret"]');if(!on||!on.classList.contains('on'))return false;var vis=function(sel){var e=document.querySelector(sel);if(!e)return false;var r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>0&&r.height>0;};return vis('[data-scale]') && !vis('[data-cofhero]') && vis('[data-soundtoggle]') && vis('[data-speedtoggle]');})()

steps.label: NO burger on a videoless Studio (it held one item over the Settings-gear position); the slim Add-a-video row stands in and the paste box stays collapsed
the SONG'S OWN chords light up: C, G, Am, F carry .inSong; the other in-key chips (Dm, Em, Bdim) stay neutral
Circle view swaps the visual (wheel visible, fretboard + scale chips + guide hidden), chords-in-key stays, and the choice persists
steps.js: (function(){var vis=function(sel){var e=document.querySelector(sel);if(!e)return false;var r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>0&&r.height>0;};if(!vis('[data-cofhero]')||vis('[data-scale]')||vis('[data-scalechips]'))return false;if(!vis('[data-chords]'))return false;var p=null;try{p=localStorage.getItem('music.studioView.v1');}catch(e){}return p==='cof';})()

steps.label: the Add-a-video row expands the gated paste box on demand (one affordance, collapsed by default)
and back: Fretboard returns, persisted
steps.js: (function(){var vis=function(sel){var e=document.querySelector(sel);if(!e)return false;var r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>0&&r.height>0;};var p=null;try{p=localStorage.getItem('music.studioView.v1');}catch(e){}return vis('[data-scale]') && !vis('[data-cofhero]') && p==='fret';})()
